overall_score.description: Weighted overall rubric score between 1.0 (clear fail) and 4.0 (strong hire).

hire_signal.description: Final recommendation based on calibrated rubric thresholds.

evidence_quote.description: Verbatim quote from candidate transcript or specific code line justifying score.

rationale.description: Adversarial, non-inflated justification comparing candidate actions to rubric anchors.

top_weaknesses.description: Top 1 to 3 critical weaknesses observed during the session.

recommended_drills.description: Concrete practice drills or architectural concepts to review next.

summary.description: Concise executive debrief of candidate performance.
